gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Prospective Pivotal Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Avastin® Bevacizumab (BEV) With or Without Microbubble-mediated Focused Ultrasound (FUS-MB) Using NaviFUS System in Recurrent Glioblastoma Multiforme Patients

Patients diagnosed with glioblastoma must have unequivocal evidence of recurrence, as determined by contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (CE-MRI), following prior radiotherapy and temozolomide chemotherapy.

candidate_evidence.quote: The study aims to compare the efficacy of combining Bevacizumab with NaviFUS System relative to Bevacizumab alone in patients with rGBM who have previously undergone radiotherapy and temozolomide chemotherapy.
[DRUG] Microbubble (other names: SonoVue): Open the Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB) using focused ultrasound and microbubble

candidate_flag.reason: Bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy (rule 6) but its FUS-enabled delivery is the question (C12/R5 device-dependent candidate); conflict decides S6.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients diagnosed with glioblastoma must have unequivocal evidence of recurrence, as determined by contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (CE-MRI), following prior radiotherapy and temozolomide chemotherapy.

role_evidence.quote: BEV represents the physician's best choice for the standard of care in rGBM after previous treatment with surgery (if appropriate), standard radiotherapy with temozolomide chemotherapy, and with adjuvant temozolomide.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody (established GBM therapy, D6)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: An anti-angiogenic agent to block tumor growth

flag.reason: Established GBM therapy whose FUS-enabled delivery is the investigational question; rule 6 vs C12/R5 candidate.

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Microbubble (other names: SonoVue): Open the Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB) using focused ultrasound and microbubble

agents.drug_class_hint: SonoVue sulfur hexafluoride microbubble ultrasound contrast agent, used for FUS BBB opening

coder_notes: Bevacizumab given IV at the same dose in both arms; the experimental arm adds microbubble + NaviFUS BBB opening. Coded bevacizumab as established_therapy_experiment (D6 established therapy, decision tree routes established therapies out of candidates), device_dependent set true per R4 because delivery is paired with FUS. Alternative reading: under C12/R5 bevacizumab would be a device-dependent experimental_monotherapy candidate (regimen monotherapy), making the trial eligible; flagged uncertain for adjudication. In the control arm bevacizumab is the active comparator. SonoVue moiety given as sulfur hexafluoride. Glioblastoma multiforme wording -> historical.
